rationale: The target and SG-3 require characterising whether unintended braking occurs. Vehicle braking behaviour is therefore itself part of the phenomenon, not merely a control mechanism affecting its evaluation. H-3 directly supports the stated operational context and unexpected braking without a forward obstacle. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: Vehicle braking behaviour as the property to be characterised.
Straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead and good weather, as specified in H-3.
The scope explicitly includes whether braking occurs unexpectedly in the absence of a relevant forward obstacle.
